about: The Kame House of Dragon Ball Z: a pink two-floor house on a grey stone base, a red roof of tile rows, KAME HOUSE in red letters on the front gable, a small red roof over the door. Made by code (web/gen/builders/kame-house.js, from pixel-scene version-3). width (x), depth (z), walls: wall height, roof: roof height over the walls, overhang: how far the roof goes past the walls, text: the lines on the gable.
